messages:
mikeb: Heads-up: CI perf suite flagged a regression on the paged-FlashAttention variant when prefill->decode switch happens. Seeing ~30-60ms extra decode tail for 1-4 token steps. Threading the profiler now. /cc @anya-r @jordan
perf-bot: benchmark/ci: 1923456788 : 99th latency increased 42ms on gpu-c5-smallbatch-flash-paged :chart_with_upwards_trend:
anya-r: Can you upload the flame? rough guess: TLB misses or KV cache page-table churn causing memcpy hotspots.
jordan: I reproduced locally with continuous_batching + kvpage_size=64. Failure appears only when prefill writes with padded stride != decoder read stride. decode path falls into a slower memcpy/fallback.
mikeb: Here is the quick trace I ran:
```
perf trace --pid 1234 --span 30s --filter 'flash_paged*' 
# sample output lines
flash_paged_prefill_write   18.2%
kvpage_compact_memcpy       12.7%  <-- suspect
flash_paged_decode_read      9.1%
```
sylvia: Did we change prefill-alignment paddings in PR #4721? that could change kernel stride detection and make decoder choose a non-coalesced path.
mikeb: Yes PR #4721 tweaked prefill to pad kv rows to 32 bytes for better prefill coalescing. Looks like decode code still assumes pad=16. I'll try toggling pad back and rerun the bench.
anya-r: The flame shows an extra memcpy on decode: memcpy(kvpage->device, offset=0x4000, len=0x2000). That smells like page compaction/realignment triggered by the kernel mismatch.
jordan: Quick local test: revert pad to 16 in runtime config and small-batch decode 99p latency returns to baseline. Repro and fix look straightforward.
mikeb: Can you open a hotfix PR? also add a small regression test for prefill/decoder stride compatibility. :thumbsup:
sylvia: Agree. Also add e2e perf check for small-batch decode with continuous_batching enabled in CI matrix — we missed that combination.
devops-bot: deploy-bench: night-bench scheduled on gpu-c5 cluster in 1h. Notifying relevant teams.
jordan: PR #4732 opened with revert + unit test. https://git.redwood/xyz/pulls/4732
anya-r: After hotfix, let's add lightweight telemetry: emit metric `kv.stride_mismatch` when decoder_stride != prefill_stride (low-cardinality). We can alert if rate > 0.1% of decodes.
mikeb: Good plan. I'll re-run night-bench and post numbers here. Thanks everyone. :pray:
